title: ICU equipment utilization below target
description: Advanced Ventilator Fleet utilization has dropped to 68% against a target of 80%.
reason: Seasonal decrease in critical care admissions combined with equipment downtime for maintenance.
suggested_action: Review maintenance scheduling to minimize downtime during peak admission periods.

title: Emergency operational cost increased 14%
description: Emergency department operational costs have risen by 14% over the last quarter while revenue grew only 3%.
reason: Increased overtime staffing costs, higher supply consumption, and rising trauma case complexity.
suggested_action: Conduct a detailed cost audit focusing on staffing patterns and supply chain efficiency.

title: Emergency waiting time increased 18%
description: Average emergency waiting time has increased from 32 to 38 minutes over the past 3 months.
reason: Patient volume increase of 12% without proportional staffing adjustment.
suggested_action: Review triage protocols and consider adding evening shift staff during peak hours.

title: Orthopedics ROI declining for 3 consecutive periods
description: Department ROI has declined from 42% to 34% over the last quarter.
reason: Patient volume decreased while fixed costs (especially robotic surgery system) remain constant.
suggested_action: Investigate patient referral patterns and marketing for orthopedic services. Review robotic surgery system utilization.

title: Bed occupancy expected to exceed capacity next month
description: ICU bed occupancy predicted to reach 96% next month based on current admission trends.
reason: Consistent upward trend in critical care admissions with limited bed expansion capacity.
suggested_action: Coordinate with General Medicine to review step-down protocols and discharge planning to free ICU beds.

title: Emergency readmission rate above threshold
description: Emergency readmission rate at 6.8% exceeds the target of 5%.
reason: Short observation periods and insufficient follow-up after emergency treatment.
suggested_action: Implement 48-hour follow-up calls and review discharge protocols for high-risk patients.

title: Cardiology equipment performing above expectations
description: Cardiac Catheterization Lab utilization at 78%, generating strong ROI.
reason: Increased cardiac procedure referrals and efficient scheduling.
suggested_action: Consider extending operating hours to capture additional patient demand.

title: Cardiology operational expenditure rising
description: Cardiology costs have increased 8% while revenue increased only 5%.
reason: New equipment maintenance contracts and specialist hiring costs.
suggested_action: Review vendor contracts for maintenance services and optimize staff scheduling.

title: Orthopedics robotic surgery system underutilized
description: Robotic Surgery System utilization at 48% — significantly below the 70% target.
reason: Low surgical case volume and limited surgeon training on the new system.
suggested_action: Accelerate surgeon training programs and explore partnerships with referring physicians to increase case referrals.
